workOrderId.title: Work Order Id
workOrderId.description: Current work order Salesforce id. Pass currentRecordId when the user does not name a wagon or work order.

assetId.title: Asset Id
assetId.description: Optional wagon or wheelset Asset id.

minValue.title: Min Value
minValue.description: Lower bound for the measure value. Set from phrases like 'measures over 20', 'greater than 20', 'above 20' becomes 20. Leave blank for no lower bound.

maxValue.title: Max Value
maxValue.description: Upper bound for the measure value. Set from phrases like 'measures under 5', 'less than 5', 'below 5' becomes 5. Leave blank for no upper bound.

measureOutcome.title: Measure Outcome
measureOutcome.description: Comma-separated outcome filter. Valid values: Scrap, Attention Required, Measure, OK. Map the user's words: 'scrap' becomes Scrap, 'require attention' / 'attention required' / 'needs attention' becomes Attention Required, 'ok' / 'passing' becomes OK. 'show scrap or require attention' becomes 'Scrap,Attention Required'. Leave blank for all outcomes.

valueType.title: Measure Value Type
valueType.description: Measurement type filter. Valid values: Temperature, Pressure, Level, Width, Length, Depth. Set from e.g. 'temperature readings' becomes Temperature. Leave blank for all types.
